body:
I've added support for the `cssClass` attribute, to be able to add a custom `form-control` class when using Bootstrap. Turns out that we will actually need more than that. In that case, we will also need to add a custom `id` on the select, so we can correctly set the `for` of the `label`.

I don't want to explicitly list all the attributes that can be passed and that I will copy on to the inner `select`. I think the best way would be to let the user define its own template, that MUST be a `select` element and use that one if provided (this is already discussed above).

The issue is that I have no idea how to add handler (or more generally do DOM manipulation) inside React without a JSX template. I mean I'll have to import a DOM element through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, and then add a `onChange` handler to that element. Maybe using `React.findDOMNode`? cc @bobylito
